---
title: "Model derivation"
---

The nationwide model `lhm_coupled` is built in stages, which the [DVC pipeline](../dev/dvc.qmd) runs in order.
Each authority starts from its own kind of data, so there are three routes to a model that are merged at the end:

- The [main water system](main-watersystem.qmd) of Rijkswaterstaat.
- The [gravity controlled](gravity-controlled.qmd) models of 11 water authorities, which mostly drain freely (vrij afwaterend), lumped from their watercourses.
- The [level controlled](level-controlled.qmd) models of 10 water authorities, which keep target levels in their polders (peilbeheerst), built from the crossings of their watercourses with the boundaries of their level areas.

![The authorities by the route of their model.](https://s3.deltares.nl/ribasim-nl/doc-image/figures/national-models.png){width=60% fig-alt="Map of the Netherlands with the main water system in blue, gravity controlled water authorities in orange and level controlled water authorities in green."}

## The stages

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "The stages of the pipeline, grouped. Blue stages run per authority. The [full graph](../dev/dvc.qmd#fig-dvc-pipeline) has 81 stages."
flowchart TB
  subgraph main["Main water system"]
    direction TB
    bathymetry --> hws_demand --> hws_transient
  end
  subgraph gravity["Gravity controlled, 11 authorities"]
    direction TB
    hydamo --> lumped --> parameterized --> bergend --> dynamic
  end
  subgraph level["Level controlled, 10 authorities"]
    direction TB
    postprocessed --> crossings --> shortest_paths --> boezemmodel --> feedback --> profiles --> forcing
  end
  rwzi --> hws_transient
  rwzi --> dynamic
  rwzi --> forcing
  peilbeheer --> dynamic
  peilbeheer --> forcing
  peilbeheer --> koppelen
  hws_transient --> samenvoegen
  dynamic --> samenvoegen
  forcing --> samenvoegen
  samenvoegen --> koppelen --> run_lhm_coupled
  run_lhm_coupled --> validate_lhm_coupled
  run_lhm_coupled --> export_webmap
  run_lhm_coupled --> hws_plus
  run_lhm_coupled -.-> delwaq

  classDef perauthority fill:#cde2fb,stroke:#2a78d6
  class hydamo,lumped,parameterized,bergend,dynamic,postprocessed,crossings,shortest_paths,boezemmodel,feedback,profiles,forcing perauthority
```

| Stage | What it does | See |
|:------|:-------------|:----|
| `bathymetry`, `hws_demand`, `hws_transient` | The model of the main water system. | [Main water system](main-watersystem.qmd) |
| `hydamo`, `lumped` | Lump the watercourses and structures into an input model. | [Lumping](lumping.qmd) |
| `parameterized`, `bergend`, `dynamic` | Fix and parameterize the model, add control, storage basins and forcing. | [Gravity controlled](gravity-controlled.qmd) |
| `postprocessed`, `crossings`, `shortest_paths`, `boezemmodel` | Make an input model from the deliveries. | [Level controlled](level-controlled.qmd) |
| `feedback`, `profiles`, `forcing` | Process the feedback of the water board, add profiles, control and forcing. | [Level controlled](level-controlled.qmd), [Profile generation](profile-generation.qmd) |
| `rwzi` | The wastewater treatment plants, as a model to merge. | [Forcing](forcing.qmd#sec-rwzi) |
| `peilbeheer` | The summer and winter levels of the level areas. | [Summer and winter levels](seasonal-levels.qmd) |
| `samenvoegen`, `koppelen` | Merge all models, and connect them where they meet. | [Coupling](couple.qmd) |
| `run_lhm_coupled`, `validate_lhm_coupled` | Run the model and check its results. | [Testing](../dev/testing.qmd#coupled-model-result-checks) |
| `export_webmap` | Export the run for the model viewer. | [Model viewer](../dev/viewer.qmd) |
| `hws_plus` | Cut the main water system out of the run, with its exchanges as boundaries. | [HWS plus](hws-plus.qmd) |
| `delwaq` | The water quality of the run with Delwaq. Only runs on demand, since it needs a Delft3D installation. | [Ribasim-Delwaq](https://github.com/Deltares/Ribasim-NL/tree/main/notebooks/ribasim_delwaq#readme) |

## Where the data is

Everything is under `data`, with a folder per authority, named as in `ribasim_nl.aquo`, and `Basisgegevens` for national data:

| Folder | Content |
|:-------|:--------|
| `<authority>/aangeleverd` | Data as delivered by the authority |
| `<authority>/verwerkt` | Processed data, including hand-made edits such as `model_edits.gpkg` |
| `<authority>/modellen` | The models of each stage, such as `<authority>_dynamic_model` |
| `Rijkswaterstaat/modellen` | Also the merged `lhm_parts` and coupled `lhm_coupled` models |
| `Rijkswaterstaat/runs/lhm_coupled` | The latest run of the coupled model, with its `results` |
| `Rijkswaterstaat/runs/lhm_coupled_delwaq` | A copy of that run with the emissions and the Delwaq results of the `delwaq` stage |
| `Basisgegevens/Delwaq` | The emission data of the `delwaq` stage |

[Get data](../dev/index.qmd#get-data) explains how to download these.

## Node IDs {#sec-node-ids}

Scripts and edit files refer to nodes by their ID, in the model of the authority.
Merging keeps these unique by prefixing them with the `waterbeheercode` of the authority, see `ribasim_nl.aquo`:

$$\text{node ID in the coupled model} = \text{waterbeheercode} \times 100\,000 + \text{node ID in the regional model}$$

So 203892 is node 3892 of Wetterskip Fryslân, with code 2, and 8009406 is node 9406 of Rijkswaterstaat, with code 80.
The model viewer shows the same IDs.
Fix a problem in the stages of the authority where possible, rather than in the coupling, so that the regional model and the nationwide model stay alike.

The IDs must stay the same on every run, or all these references break, see [Reproducing models](../dev/reproducing-models.qmd).
